# A — Closes and their corrections (evidence reader A, 2026-10-03)

Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-03). Facts from the record only; every row cites file:line and quotes the deciding words. Line numbers are those of the files as read on 2026-10-03 (`LOG.md` 2317 lines, `STATUS.md` 635 lines).

## Plan (at most 20 lines)
1. Map LOG.md l. 2061–2309 (Sessions 36–41): one line per entry, first 300 characters, to locate announcements and closes.
2. Read STATUS.md l. 26 header chain in windows for each session's headline labels (CLOSED, PROVED, COUNTEREXAMPLE, NEW, CERTIFIED).
3. Verify the brief's starting points at the line: Conjecture U counterexample (S39 to S40); conj-O-s38 Lemma G (S38 to S39); Theorem 1.6 and Lemma B_rho (S40 to S41); "beta = 0" narrowed; novelty relabels (Olofsson 2010, Winkelmann 2002, Bertrand 1997); Session 7 "C3-r FULLY CLOSED" and alkl23 repairs (S14–17).
4. Read the §E errata of the three wave digests (s36, s37, s39) for withdrawn or narrowed results.
5. List every read-O.md and read-F.md in Session 36–41 folders; grep each for verdict words (FIX-FIRST, withdraw, narrow, not new, false, overstated).
6. Earlier sessions at lower resolution: grep LOG.md for WITHDRAWN|withdrawn|retracted|RETRACTED|narrowed|relabel|pre-empted|downgrad|demoted|record correction|repair.
7. Build Table 1 (announced, then corrected) five rows at a time; Table 2 (conditional results and their missing piece); Table 3 (announcements that held).
8. Counts (per table; Table 1 split by catcher and by lag), then "Wording at announcement" one word per row with the quote.
9. Append a dated block to SHARED.md after each batch.

## Wording at announcement (Table 1 rows)

Word: **same** = the open part stated in the same sentence as the claim; **paragraph** = only elsewhere in the same entry or paragraph (usually a generic "report level", "single-check", "pending the reads"); **none** = not stated. ## What I could not check

- Every NOTE at the line: the corrections are quoted from the LOG entries, the reads and the digests; the NOTE texts were opened only where a row needed the announcement's own words (`compute`, `theory`, `s5-multiplicity-s40`, `local-greedy-s40`, `dz-half-s39`, `fejer-form-s39` pre-reader copies).
- The announcement session of zoo entry I.2(b) (row 36) and the origin of the "manifold kill" reopened in S16 (row b19): not traced at the line.
- Sessions 7–35 were read through the pattern grep only (Table 1b); corrections there phrased without the brief's patterns (for example "FIX-FIRST", "overstated", "false as") are not in Table 1b. In Sessions 35–41 those words were also searched (via the read files and digests).
- The 3 announcements of Session 41 without a completed check (U2, U4, U5's close) and the unreconciled read-O findings of U1 and U5 (rows 30, 31) may change at the Session 42 reconciliation, which is not on the record yet.
- The side-sessions of 2026-10-02/03 (`LOG.md` l. 2289–2317) contain no research announcements and were not tabulated; their study's own corrections (`results/external/cogentic-2026/read-O.md` F4, F6, F12) are cited in `BRIEF-WARNINGS.md` l. 24.
